title: Register as a breeder before selling dogs or cats
what: Sell dogs or cats the business has bred only while registered as a breeder (or registered with an approved body or another jurisdiction).

sources.title: Dog and Cat Management Act 1995 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not sell a dog or cat that he or she has bred unless— (a) he or she is registered as a breeder under this Part
